text:
tara: noticing a weird signal on latency dashboards for /embed: p50 and p95 look fine but p99 jumped ~600ms around the time we enabled quota-enforcement. anyone else seeing this? :confused:

devon: can you share the time slice & the query you used? quantile merges + small sample groups can make p99 hop around.

tara: pulling the comparison: https://console.redwood/local/dash?endpoint=/embed&by=route,client_version

lee: hmm the route that got more traffic after quota enforcement has many short requests; p50/p95 drop as expected, but p99 seems dominated by a tiny set of long requests still routed to the legacy route. sample_count for legacy route is ~40 in that window.

lisa: small n is the usual suspect. also check where we filter out aborted requests. if they are only excluded on the main route, that's a bias.

ops-bot: Config change applied at 4691234000: quota.enforcement:/embed=true by @infra :gear:

devon: another angle: our TDigest quantile estimates have error bounds that depend on merge ordering; merging many small digests can inflate p99. we could add a stability metric (CI) to the API.

ux-amy: UX thought: show a "percentile provenance" pill that expands to show a tiny stacked bar: fraction of samples by route/client_version that contributed above each percentile. lightweight, inline.

tara: love that. would help PMs understand whether tail is from a small client cohort.

lee: ops note: the legacy route had a client-version rollout key that we forgot to include in the weight shift. i think older SDKs still go to legacy. concentrates the tail.

devon: proposal: telemetry API returns per-quantile provenance: for each quantile, list top N contributors (route, count, percentage) and an "effective_count" number. that keeps dashboard fast but gives context.

lisa: agree, but be careful with perf. we should compute provenance at the routing-aggregation stage, not full-trace join. small additional fields on the aggregation proto should be fine.

ux-amy: in the console we can add a small red "unstable" chevron next to p99 if effective_count < 250 or if CI width > threshold. clicking it expands the provenance pill.

devon: long-term we should also decide whether to expose bootstrap CI from bucketed data or rely on analytic TDigest error bounds. I'll draft a short RFC comparing approaches.

ops-bot: Alert: rollout-event:/embed/weights changed at 4691233900 by @releases - old_weights={main:0.9,legacy:0.1} new_weights={main:0.6,legacy:0.4} :loud_sound:

tara: that matches timing. thanks ops.

lee: next steps: 1) temporary dashboard annotation for recent rollout/weight changes (small banner) 2) add p99 unstable chevron + provenance pill 3) telemetry API change proposal (effective_count + top contributors) 4) ops to verify aborted request filtering is consistent across routes.

lisa: i'll scope the aggregation proto change and estimate perf impact.

devon: i'll start the RFC for TDigest vs bootstrap and include a small experiment plan.

ux-amy: i'll mock the chevron + pill and the stacked contributor mini-bar. aim to keep it subtle.

tara: thanks all. can we target a quick follow-up check-in in 3d after we have mocks & proto numbers?

ops-bot: Ticket created: ENGPLAT-8421 "percentile provenance + effective_count" assigned to lisa, devon (4691234600) :ticket:
